list.snippet: 1. Measure Deck Area: Measure the length and width of your deck in feet, and multiply them to get the total square footage.
Example: $20\text{ ft (length)} \times 13\text{ ft (width)} = 260\text{ sq. ft}$ Decks.com +1
2. Calculate Board Area: Multiply the length of your chosen deck board by its width (remembering to convert inches to feet by dividing by 12).
Example: An 8 ft board by 6 in wide: 8 ft × 0.5 ft = 4 sq. ft per board
3. Estimate Boards Needed: Divide the deck square footage by the board square footage, then multiply by 1.10 for waste/cuts.
Example: 260 ÷ 4 = 65. Add 10% for waste → 65 × 1.10 = 71.5, which rounds up to 72 boards. YouTube·Buyers Guides +1
